#!/bin/bash
set -euxo pipefail
cd /workspace
git config --global --add safe.directory /workspace
PATCH="$(dirname "$0")/patch.diff"
git apply --verbose --reject "$PATCH"

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
python3 - <<'PYCONTROL'
import ast
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/Bio/SeqFeature.py')
s=p.read_text()
tree=ast.parse(s)
cls=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) and n.name=='SimpleLocation')
assert not any(isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='__hash__' for n in cls.body)
eq=next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='__eq__')
lines=s.splitlines(keepends=True)
lines.insert(eq.end_lineno,'\n    def __hash__(self):\n        return hash((self.ref_db, self.ref, self._strand, self._end, self._start))\n')
s=''.join(lines)
ast.parse(s)
p.write_text(s)
PYCONTROL
